name: Photo Mosaic
tagline: Minimal white photo-collage deck with gray typography and offset vertical image strips.

palette.description: White background, charcoal gray text, pale gray rules, and photo strips as the primary visual energy.

typography.style: Simple gray sans typography with generous whitespace.

best_for: Photo-heavy case studies, visual portfolios, travel stories, project galleries, and product moodboards.
avoid_for: Dense data decks or content without meaningful visuals.

source_inspiration.name: PPT Design Multi Photo Collage Image Mosaic Layout
source_inspiration.notes: Source-inspired HTML/CSS template rebuilt from public visual reference only; not a pixel copy and does not reuse source assets.
